senses.gloss: f. (סקף, cmp. b. h. מַשְׁקוֹף a. זקף) cross-piece;

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:1">Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 1</cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="A01202"><he>אִיזְקָפָה</he></cite>); Y. ib. V, beg. 15ᵃ in selling a vessel one has not implicitly sold <he>את הא׳</he> the yard (because it is taken down when on land; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Antenna).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 103:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIII</cite> (the embryo in the womb) <he>כאדם שנתון באסקופת וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>בספינה</he>, read <he>באִסְקוּפַת הספינה</he>) like a person seated on the yard on open Sea.
<cite ref="Shabbat 6a:2">Sabb. 6ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.; cmp. Y. Ber. V, 37ᵃ, expl. <cite ref="O01308"><he>סַף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:3:5">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>עשה אותי</he> (<cite ref="K00000"><he>כ</he></cite>)<he>א׳</he> make me the threshold for the Law to pass over me; i.e. let the law have its course at the expense of my life; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 688">Yalk. Ps. 688</cite> <he>עשה אסקופא</he> (corr. acc.).
